## Fig. 1: Precip bars
```{r Precip data}
precip.dat<-read.csv(file="final_data/SGS_EW_Precipitation_Selected_v2.csv")
str(precip.dat)

## mutate needed columns
daily.precip<-precip.dat%>%
  mutate(new.Date=as.Date(Date,format="%m/%d/%y"))%>%
  group_by(yr=year(new.Date),mon)%>%
  rename(amb_tot=ambient_ppt_mm,added_tot=added_ppt_mm)%>%
  mutate(amb_adj=if_else(amb_tot < 0.3, 0, amb_tot))%>%
  mutate(added_adj=if_else(added_tot < 0.3, 0, added_tot))%>%
  select(new.Date,yr,mon,growing_season,amb_tot,amb_adj,added_tot,added_adj,source)

str(daily.precip)

## calculate gs precip by month
gs.monthly<-daily.precip%>%
  group_by(yr,mon)%>%
  filter(growing_season == "YES")%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.days=n(),
    gs_amb_sum=sum(amb_tot,na.rm=TRUE),
    gs_amb_adj=sum(amb_adj,na.rm=TRUE),
    gs_add_sum=sum(added_tot,na.rm=TRUE),
    gs_add_adj=sum(added_adj,na.rm=TRUE))

## calculate LTA gs monthly values
gs.monthly.avs<-gs.monthly%>%
  group_by(mon)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.yrs=n(),
    month_gs_LTA=mean(gs_amb_sum),
    month_gs_LTA_SE=(sd(gs_amb_sum)/sqrt(n.yrs)),
    month_gs_LTA_adj=mean(gs_amb_adj),
    month_gs_LTA_SE_adj=(sd(gs_amb_adj)/sqrt(n.yrs)))

## combined gs monthly and LTA monthlys
gs.to.comb<-gs.monthly%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c("gs_amb_sum","gs_add_sum","gs_amb_adj","gs_add_adj"),
               names_to="amb_add",values_to="mm_precip")%>%
  rename(n=n.days)%>%
  mutate(SE=NA,
         yr=as.factor(yr))
  
gs.LTA.to.comb<-gs.monthly.avs%>%
  rename(mm_precip=month_gs_LTA,
         SE=month_gs_LTA_SE,
         n=n.yrs)

gs.all.comb<-merge(gs.to.comb,gs.monthly.avs,by="mon")

gs.gr.comb<-filter(gs.all.comb,yr %in% c("2022","2023","2024"))%>%
  group_by(yr,amb_add)%>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c(mm_precip,month_gs_LTA_adj),names_to="precip_groups2",values_to="precip_total")%>%
  mutate(mon=factor(mon))

view(gs.gr.comb)


#### plotting monthly bars ####
gr_dat<-gs.gr.comb%>%
  filter(amb_add %in% c("gs_amb_adj","gs_add_adj","amb_LTA"))%>%
  filter(!amb_add == "gs_add_adj")%>%
  mutate(precip_groups2=factor(precip_groups2,levels=c("month_gs_LTA_adj","mm_precip")))%>%
  mutate(SE = case_when(
    precip_groups2 == "month_gs_LTA_adj" ~ month_gs_LTA_SE_adj,
    precip_groups2 == "mm_precip" ~ SE))

# gr_dat<-gr_dat%>%
#   filter(mon %in% c(5:7))

monthly.precip.bars<-ggplot(data=gr_dat,color=precip_groups2,group=precip_groups2,x=mon,y=precip_total)+
  geom_bar(aes(x=mon,y=precip_total,fill=precip_groups2),
           color="black",
           width=0.85,
           position=position_dodge(0.85),
           stat="identity",
           linewidth=0.25)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x=mon,ymin=precip_total-SE,ymax=precip_total+SE,group=precip_groups2),
                position=position_dodge(0.85),
                width=0.15,
                linewidth=0.25,
                color="black")+
  labs(title=NULL,y=(expression(bold("Monthly precipitation (mm)"))),x=NULL)+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,110),expand=c(0,0),sec.axis=dup_axis(labels=NULL,name=NULL))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("4"="Apr","5"="May","6"="Jun","7"="July","8"="Aug","9"="Sep"))+
  scale_fill_manual(name=NULL,
                    values=c("gray70","#F4B942"),
                    labels=c("LTA Total",
                             "Ambient Total"))+
  coord_cartesian(clip="off")+
  theme_classic()+
  plot_theme+
  theme(
    legend.position="inside",
    legend.position.inside=c(0.76,0.85),
    axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
    legend.text=element_text(size=8),
    legend.key.size=unit(0.6,"lines"))+
  guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes=list(size=2.5)))+
  facet_wrap(~yr,ncol=3)+
  force_panelsizes(rows=unit(1.5,"in"),
                   cols=unit(2,"in"))

monthly.precip.bars

#### export monthly bars Apr-June ####
# ggsave(monthly.precip.bars,filename="fig_exports/MS_Final_Plots/SGS_EW_Precip_April-Sept.pdf",height=8.5,width=11,units="in")

#### Table Values ####
glimpse(daily.precip)

## annual totals
MAP<-daily.precip%>%
  group_by(yr)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.days=n(),
    MAP=sum(amb_adj,na.rm=TRUE),
    MAP.add=sum(added_adj,na.rm=TRUE))

MAP.21_24<-MAP%>%
  filter(yr %in% c(2021:2024))

LTA.MAP<-MAP%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.yrs=n(),
    LTA=mean(MAP),
    LTA.SE=(sd(MAP))/sqrt(n.yrs))

## growing season totals
GSP<-daily.precip%>%
  filter(growing_season=="YES")%>%
  group_by(yr)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.days=n(),
    GSP=sum(amb_adj,na.rm=TRUE),
    GSP.add=sum(added_adj,na.rm=TRUE))

GSP.21_24<-GSP%>%
  filter(yr %in% c(2021:2024))

LTA.GSP<-GSP%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.yrs=n(),
    LTA=mean(GSP),
    LTA.SE=(sd(GSP))/sqrt(n.yrs))

# Annual (MAP) percentiles
MAP.percentiles <- MAP %>%
  mutate(
    pct_rank = round(percent_rank(MAP) * 100, 1)  # percentile among all years
  ) %>%
  filter(yr %in% c(2021:2024)) %>%
  select(yr, MAP, pct_rank)

# Growing season (GSP) percentiles
GSP.percentiles <- GSP %>%
  mutate(
    pct_rank = round(percent_rank(GSP) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  filter(yr %in% c(2021:2024)) %>%
  select(yr, GSP, pct_rank)
```


## Fig. 2: VWC plots
```{r VWC data}
vwc.20<-read.csv("final_data/SGS_EW_20cm_VWC.csv")

vwc.20.no.na<-vwc.20%>%
  # set date formats
  mutate(new.Date=as.Date(Full.Date,format="%m/%d/%y"),yr=year(new.Date),mon=month(new.Date))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=paste("2024",mon,day(new.Date),sep="-"))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=as.Date(short.Date,format="%Y-%m-%d"))%>%
  # rename variables from original file
  rename(TRT.2022=Trt_2022)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2022=factor(TRT.2022,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  rename(TRT.2023=Trt_2023)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2023=factor(TRT.2023,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  # select columns to keep
  select(c(new.Date,short.Date,yr,mon,Plot,TRT.2022,TRT.2023,VWC,Notes))%>%
  # drop rows with VWC NA's
  drop_na(VWC)%>%
  # create Unique_ID for dropping specific observations (outliers)
  mutate(Unique_ID=paste(new.Date,"_Plot",Plot,sep=""))

str(vwc.20) # 1900 observations
str(vwc.20.no.na) # 1900 observations

vwc.20cm.2024<-subset(vwc.20.no.na,yr=="2024")
vwc.20cm.2023<-subset(vwc.20.no.na,yr=="2023")


```

### a) 2022 - across gs
```{r 2022 VWC}
# subset 2022 and remove outliers from daily analysis
vwc.20cm.2022<-subset(vwc.20.no.na,yr=="2022")%>%
  mutate(resp = VWC) # no outliers
str(vwc.20cm.2022)

# average for plotting
gs.avs.22<-vwc.20cm.2022%>%
  group_by(Plot,TRT.2022)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.samp.dates = n(),
    season.av = mean(resp),
    season.sd = sd(resp),
    season.SE = season.sd/sqrt(n.samp.dates))

gs.plot.avs.22<-gs.avs.22%>%
  group_by(TRT.2022)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.plots=n(),
    av = mean(season.av),
    sd = sd(season.av),
    SE = sd/sqrt(n.plots))

#### Fig 2a ####
fi.name<-"fig_exports/Rev1_Plots/SGS_EW_F2a_VWC.pdf"

y.lab<-expression(paste(bold("20 cm Soil"["VWC"]*" (%)")))
ylims=c(0,57)
p.val="p < 0.0001"
text.y=37

gs.22.plot<-ggplot(data=gs.plot.avs.22,aes(x=TRT.2022,y=av,fill=TRT.2022))+
  labs(title=expression(bold("2022")),y=y.lab,x=NULL,tag="")+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=ylims,expand=c(0,0),sec.axis=dup_axis(labels=NULL,name=NULL))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("amb"="D","wet"="Av"),
                   # expand=expansion(0.85)
                   )+
  geom_col(width=0.75,color="black",position=position_dodge(0.75))+
  scale_fill_manual(name=NULL,
                    values=c("#F4B942","#4059AD"))+
  scale_pattern_manual(values=c(NA,NA))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=av-SE,ymax=av+SE),
                position=position_dodge(0.75),
                width=0.1,linewidth=0.25,
                color="black")+
  coord_cartesian(clip="off")+
  plot_theme+
  theme(axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1,size=9))+
  geom_text(data=subset(gs.plot.avs.22,TRT.2022=="amb"),
            label=p.val,
            x=1.5,y=text.y,
            color="black",
            size=9/.pt,
            fontface="bold")+
  force_panelsizes(rows = unit(1.25,"in"),
                   cols = unit(0.85, "in"))
  
gs.22.plot
```

### Supplemental: 2022-2024 line graphs
```{r VWC lines}
#### combined outlier removed data and organize ####
str(vwc.20cm.2022)
str(vwc.20cm.2023)
str(vwc.20cm.2024)

vwc.no.out<-rbind(vwc.20cm.2022,vwc.20cm.2023,vwc.20cm.2024)
str(vwc.no.out)

vwc.daily.avs<-vwc.no.out%>%
  mutate(new.Date=as.Date(new.Date,format="%Y-%m-%d"))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=as.Date(short.Date,format="%Y-%m-%d"))%>%
  mutate(TRT.2022=factor(TRT.2022,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  mutate(TRT.2023=factor(TRT.2023,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  mutate(full.TRT=paste(TRT.2022,TRT.2023,sep="-"))%>%
  mutate(full.TRT=factor(full.TRT,levels=c("amb-NA","wet-NA","amb-amb","wet-amb","amb-wet","wet-wet")))%>%
    mutate(mon.lab=fct_recode(as.factor(mon),
                               "May"="5",
                               "Jun"="6",
                               "Jul"="7",
                               "Aug"="8",
                               "Sep"="9"))%>%
  group_by(yr,mon,new.Date,short.Date,TRT.2022,TRT.2023,full.TRT)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.plots=n(),
    av=mean(VWC,na.rm=TRUE),
    sd=sd(VWC,na.rm=TRUE),
    SE=sd/sqrt(n.plots),
    plots.included=sum(!is.na(VWC)))
```

## Fig. 3: GCC plots
```{r GCC data}
gcc<-read.csv("final_data/SGS_EW_GCC_2022-2024.csv")
str(gcc)

gcc.no.na<-gcc%>%
  # set date formats
  mutate(new.Date=as.Date(Date,format="%m/%d/%y"),yr=year(new.Date),mon=month(new.Date))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=paste("2024",mon,day(new.Date),sep="-"))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=as.Date(short.Date,format="%Y-%m-%d"))%>%
  # rename variables from original file
  rename(TRT.2022=TRT_2022)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2022=factor(TRT.2022,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  rename(TRT.2023=TRT_2023)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2023=factor(TRT.2023,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  # select columns to keep
  rename(Notes=Notes.)%>%
  select(c(new.Date,short.Date,yr,mon,Plot,TRT.2022,TRT.2023,GCC,Notes))%>%
  # drop rows with VWC NA's
  drop_na(GCC)%>%
  # create Unique_ID for dropping specific observations (outliers)
  mutate(Unique_ID=paste(new.Date,"_Plot",Plot,sep=""))
```

## Fig. 4: ANPP plots
```{r ANPP data}
anpp<-read.csv("final_data/SGS_EW_ANPP_2022-2024.csv")
str(anpp)

anpp.no.na<-anpp%>%
  # rename variables from original file
  rename(TRT.2022=TRT_22,TRT.2023=TRT_23,C3.GRASSES=C3)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2022=factor(TRT.2022,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  mutate(TRT.2023=factor(TRT.2023,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  # select columns to keep
  select(c(Plot,Year,Clip,TRT.2022,TRT.2023,C3.GRASSES,C4,FORB,ANNUALS,TOTAL.GRASSES,ANPP))%>%
  # drop rows with ANPP NA's
  drop_na(ANPP)%>%
  # create Unique ID for dropping specific observations (outliers)
  mutate(Unique_ID=paste("Plot_",Plot,Clip,sep="-"))
  
str(anpp.no.na)


anpp.22<-subset(anpp.no.na,Year=="2022") # no outliers
anpp.23<-subset(anpp.no.na,Year=="2023")%>%
  filter(!Unique_ID %in% c("Plot_-12-Sept_23_clip","Plot_-2-Sept_23_clip","Plot_-31-July_23"))
anpp.24<-subset(anpp.no.na,Year=="2024") # no outliers
```

### a) 2022 ANPP - end-season only
```{r 2022 ANPP}
end.22<-subset(anpp.22,Clip=="Sept_22_clip")
glimpse(end.22)

end.plot.avs.22<-end.22%>%
  group_by(TRT.2022)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.plots=n(),
    av = mean(ANPP),
    sd = sd(ANPP),
    SE = sd/sqrt(n.plots))

fi.name<-"fig_exports/Rev1_Plots/SGS_EW_2022_ANPP_end.pdf"
y.lab<-expression(paste(bold("ANPP (g m"^"-2"*")")))
ylims=c(0,160)
p.val="p < 0.0001"
text.y=85

end.22.plot<-ggplot(data=end.plot.avs.22,aes(x=TRT.2022,y=av,color=TRT.2022,fill=TRT.2022))+
  labs(title=expression(bold("2022")),y=y.lab,x=NULL)+
  scale_y_continuous(limits=ylims,expand=c(0,0),sec.axis=dup_axis(labels=NULL,name=NULL))+
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c("amb"="D","wet"="Av"),
                   # expand=expansion(0.85)
                   )+
  geom_col(width=0.75,color="black",aes(fill=TRT.2022))+
  scale_fill_manual(name=NULL,
                    values=c("#F4B942","#4059AD"))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=av-SE,ymax=av+SE),
                position=position_dodge(0.75),
                width=0.1,linewidth=0.25,
                color="black")+
  coord_cartesian(clip="off")+
  plot_theme+
  theme(axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1,size=9))+
  geom_text(data=subset(end.plot.avs.22,TRT.2022=="amb"),
            label=paste0(p.val),
            x=1.5,y=text.y,
            color="black",
            size=9/.pt)+
  force_panelsizes(rows = unit(1.25,"in"),
                   cols = unit(0.85, "in"))
```

## Fig. 5a) Soil respiration - early vs. late
```{r Respiration data}
resp<-read.csv("final_data/SGS_EW_Efflux_2022-2023.csv")
str(resp)

resp[resp=="ambient"]<-"amb"

resp.no.na<-resp%>%
  # set date formats
  mutate(new.Date=as.Date(Full.Date,format="%m/%d/%y"),yr=year(new.Date),mon=month(new.Date))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=paste("2024",mon,day(new.Date),sep="-"))%>%
  mutate(short.Date=as.Date(short.Date,format="%Y-%m-%d"))%>%
  # rename variables from original file
  rename(TRT.2022=TRT_2022)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2022=factor(TRT.2022,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  rename(TRT.2023=TRT_2023)%>%
  mutate(TRT.2023=factor(TRT.2023,levels=c("amb","wet")))%>%
  # select columns to keep
  select(c(new.Date,short.Date,yr,mon,Plot,TRT.2022,TRT.2023,Soil.temp,Efflux,Notes))%>%
  # drop rows with VWC NA's
  drop_na(Efflux)%>%
  # create Unique_ID for dropping specific observations (outliers)
  mutate(Unique_ID=paste(new.Date,"_Plot",Plot,sep=""))

str(resp) # 721 observations
str(resp.no.na) # 712 observations
```

```{r 2023 Respiration}

  group_by(period,Plot,TRT.2022,TRT.2023)%>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n.samp.dates=n(),

    season.sd = sd(resp),
    season.SE = season.sd/sqrt(n.samp.dates))

plot.period.avs<-period.avs.23%>%

    SE = sd/sqrt(n.plots))
```
